name: Notion
tagline: All-in-one workspace — notes, docs, wikis, databases
verdictSummary: A block-based editor with markdown is doable. But Notion's database views, formula engine, and real-time collaboration are genuine engineering challenges.
moatNotes: Notion's block editor is complex but not impossible. The collaboration layer is the real challenge.
whyPeopleStillPay: Teams using Notion as their knowledge base with interconnected databases
notes: For personal note-taking with basic blocks, DIY is viable. For team wikis, use Notion or AppFlowy.
